mechanism: Bayesian posterior over reliability of skills learned from verified trajectories, driving skill repair and guardrails
evidence_scope: Bayesian-Agent records verified trajectories, maintains posterior beliefs over skill reliability and failure modes, and turns those beliefs into auditable skill actions and model-facing guardrails.
evidence_role: We introduce Bayesian-Agent, a native and cross-harness framework that treats reusable agent skills as Bayesian evidence objects.
